verdict_text: NO. The plan omits `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight` from every projection-matrix pattern, so only 48 of the required 64 matrices are cast to bfloat16 and the 16 `attention.dense.weight` tensors are left float32 — violating "Required result" clause 1 (cast exactly the 64 projection matrices listed) and clause 2 by implication. The required checks are correspondingly wrong: the plan asserts `count ... is: 48` and asserts that everything outside the 48-matrix set is float32, encoding the same off-by-16 error instead of the specified "exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16", so the run will pass silently rather than fail loudly. The deletion of the 48 buffers, the name preservation, the 196-tensor count and the 256 MiB sharded output are correct, but the dtype result does not match the reference and grading would fail on dtypes and values.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
